subject.summary: Petroleum pump system operators, refinery operators, and gaugers (O*NET 51-8093.00) monitor the instruments, pumps, valves, tanks, and pipelines of refinery or petroleum processing units, coordinate flows under the approved process plan, verify metering and product status, record readings, and report anomalies. Real control and troubleshooting must follow site procedures, training, and authorization; this page does not provide equipment operating parameters.
